entities.name: Aerath
entities.description: A small city-state in the Blue Mountains of Jamuraa on Dominaria whose people are powerful, brutish warriors.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Leader of the Northern Realms in Johan's War who sent assassins against the Aerathi clan chiefs.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: War during which the Aerathi were subjugated.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Madaran army that destroyed the Aerathi island nation and drafted survivors as elite troops.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Madaran emperor who ordered the kentsu to attack the Aerathi island.

entities.name: Madaran Empire
entities.description: Empire ruled by Nicol Bolas that fell into chaos after his death.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: Aerathi berserker who killed General Marhault Elsdragon and led the kentsu until he was killed.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: High general of the kentsu killed by Jorgan Hage.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Fought the Aerathi troops; the Aerathi claimed a blood debt with him.

entities.name: Wasitora
entities.description: Fought the Aerathi, killing Hrotgha's men.

entities.name: Kolo Meha
entities.description: One who decimated the Aerathi troops.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Companion of Tetsuo Umezawa; the Aerathi claimed a blood debt with her.

entities.name: Tetsuko Umezawa
entities.description: Fugitive of the line of Umezawa on Madara.

entities.name: Hrotgha
entities.description: Clan member of Hage who led an attack on Umezawa Manor.

entities.name: Gunamo
entities.description: Aerathi who led troops for Ayesha Tanaka and was torn in two by killer vines.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Summoned an Aerathi warrior to attack Jared Carthalion.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Target of an Aerathi attack to take the Red Mana Well.

events.summary: During Johan's War, Johan's assassins murder the three Aerathi clan chiefs and the Aerathi are subjugated into Johan's army.
events.quote: Johan sent assassins to murder the three Aerathi clan chiefs of the Blue Mountains

events.summary: Upon Johan's death the Aerathi free themselves from the Northern Realms and become independent.
events.quote: the Aerathi freed themselves from the Northern Realms and became independent once more

events.summary: The kentsu, on Nicol Bolas's order, destroys the Aerathi island nation when it refuses to surrender; survivors are forced into the kentsu.
events.quote: the kentsu destroyed the entire island

events.summary: Jorgan Hage kills General Marhault Elsdragon and takes his place as leader of the kentsu.
events.quote: Jorgan Hage killed General Marhault Elsdragon and took his place as leader of the kentsu

events.summary: Hage is killed in battle and the Aerathi troops are decimated by Tetsuo Umezawa, Wasitora and Kolo Meha.
events.quote: Hage himself was killed in battle

events.summary: After Bolas is killed the Madaran Empire falls into chaos, and remaining Aerathi claim a blood debt with Tetsuo Umezawa and Ayesha Tanaka.
events.quote: claimed a blood debt between themselves and Tetsuo Umezawa

relations.note: sent assassins to kill its chiefs
